note: Six pages, THREE documents. Every page classifies BANK_STATEMENT and prints the same bank, holder and account number, so no type change and no anchor separates them — only the printed statement period does, which is what the instance-key probe reads. Before Phase C this produced one six-page document reporting a single beginning balance for three months. Declaring the page split explicitly makes a splitter regression show up here as a document-count mismatch, not as three fields mysteriously disagreeing.
